changes.newValue: Shell (react-shell.js + index.html): on mobile (<768px) heading and metadata strip are hidden, main padding removed, iframe fills 100svh full-bleed. Viewport meta now has user-scalable=no + maximum-scale=1. Body gets overflow:hidden + overscroll-behavior:none on mobile. Desktop experience unchanged.

snapshot.title: Improve mobile web experience
snapshot.description: Tester feedback: 'The mobile experience for the web app is horrible - the text is very bad.' Multiple UX issues on mobile: text sizing, layout, button hit targets. The react-shell.js already has isMobile detection (window.innerWidth < 768) but the Godot canvas layout and UI scaling need work for mobile viewports.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Text is legible without zooming on a typical mobile screen (375px wide)
All interactive buttons have adequate hit targets (min 44px)
No UI elements overflow or clip on mobile
